errors.description: The agent is hallucinating the file content and proceeding with a fabricated input instead of acknowledging the failure to retrieve the actual file.

errors.evidence: The agent constructs a plausible file layout based on the task description, effectively fabricating the input data because it could not access the actual file.
errors.description: The agent fabricated the content of the file to proceed with the reasoning.

errors.evidence: The agent consistently attempts to read the file content instead of acknowledging the persistent failure and adapting its approach. This indicates a misidentification of the core problem – the inability to access the file – and a fixation on a failing strategy.
